title: Distance-shell tomography: product kernels and sharp grid sensing
summary: General integer-trade criterion and full-factor Cartesian-product kernel/recovery theorem; the all-order grid lower bound; and, for every n ≥ 6, the complete four-parameter integer grid kernel, exact threshold n−2 for odd n and n−3 for even n, optimal n−2 sensor count throughout 2 ≤ h < threshold, and unique four-parameter description of equal-observation populations.

formalizes.title: Distance-Shell Tomography on Graphs: Integer Trades and Optimal Grid Sensing

review.reason: Combinatorial results on distance-shell kernels and grid sensing thresholds for integer graphs.
